messages:
Ana Gomez: Hey! Starting Monday. Id like to use my personal Dell for first few days. Its Ubuntu 22.04, encrypted with LUKS, TPM present but I run most dev in Docker containers. Questions: 1) Is running dev inside containers allowed while the host is under MDM? 2) Do container images with company code need to be scanned differently on BYOD? 3) PhishSim is Tue  if my device is still pending enrollment, will I be blocked?

Mara (People Ops): Welcome Ana :wave: Short: BYOD allowed temporarily with signed MOU + agent. Containers are fine but host must meet baseline. We require CI-scanned images for any company workloads and agent must be able to inspect container runtime metadata. PhishSim: missing it won't immediately lock you out, but do complete the training quickly.

IT-helpdesk: Host requirements: LUKS full-disk, management agent installed, screensaver lock, up-to-date kernel. For containers: we require runtime auditing enabled (e.g., containerd + audit logs forwarded to agent) or use our approved devkit VM. If you want to keep images offline, we can provision a short-lived company sandbox VM. Please paste `lsblk -f` and `uname -a`.

Luca (Security): Policy bits: - BYOD must run agent (remote-wipe + cert escrow). - Company code in containers must be scanned in CI and signed; runtime must enforce image signature verification (we can enable cosign checks via the agent). - If images pull secrets, those secrets must come from the agent vault, not env vars. PhishSim: single miss = coaching + remedial module; repeated misses escalate.

Ana Gomez: Quick clarifications: a) I use Docker Desktop with rootful containers; is that ok? b) If I prefer a disposable sandbox VM, can IT provide one? c) How do I sign the MOU?

IT-helpdesk: Docker Desktop is ok if you enable our runtime audit plugin and disable privileged containers. Disposable sandbox VM = yes, we can spin a short-lived Debian VM in our cloud with preinstalled dev tools. MOU via DocuSign, Mara will send link.

Mara (People Ops): DocuSign link sent. @onboarding-bot please set Ana's security training due date to Friday and open PhishSim window.

onboarding-bot: Training assigned: "Developer Security Starter" due 2025-05-02. PhishSim window: 2025-04-29 -> 2025-05-05. Reminders: 2x.

Ana Gomez: Pasted outputs (sanitized): `uname -a`: Linux ana-dell 5.15.0-70-generic x86_64
`lsblk -f`: NAME FSTYPE
sda
sda1 vfat 1A2B-3C4D
sda2 ext4 9a8b7c6d-...
sda3 crypto_LUKS c3d2e1f0-...

Ana Gomez: Signed the MOU. I'll enable the audit plugin and either join the sandbox VM or use Docker with the agent. Thanks!
